runOnAllSitesDesc.message: Standardmäßig aus. Profi-Option: Chrome fragt nach Zugriff auf jede Website, die du besuchst. Die meisten Nutzer brauchen nur die integrierten Websites.

activeOnHostsDesc.message: Die integrierten Websites werden immer unterstützt. Um eine andere Website zu aktivieren, öffne sie, klicke auf das Symbol in der Symbolleiste und wähle „Auf dieser Website aktivieren“.

showToastOnActionDesc.message: Karte unten rechts nach jeder Aktion

toastDurationDesc.message: Wie lange der Hinweis sichtbar bleibt

activateExtensionNote.message: Der vom Browser gelistete Eintrag „Activate the extension“ / „Erweiterung aktivieren“ öffnet nur das Popup dieser Erweiterung. Er fügt keinen Opt-in-Ursprung hinzu und ist kein Hauptschalter für Commands.
activateExtensionNote.description: Shortcuts section note clarifying Chrome’s Activate the extension command.

privacyProse.message: PlaybackKeys sammelt nichts. Keine Telemetrie, keine Netzwerkanfragen, keine Analysen. Einstellungen liegen in chrome.storage auf deinem Gerät. Quellcode unter github.com/mehmetdemircs/PlaybackKeys.

privacyMeta.message: Keine Telemetrie · Keine Netzwerkanfragen · Einstellungen lokal gespeichert

confirmRunOnAllSites.message: Auf allen Websites ausführen bittet Chrome um Zugriff auf jede Website, die du besuchst. Meist reicht der Aktivieren-Schalter pro Website. Fortfahren?

confirmResetDefaults.message: Alle PlaybackKeys-Einstellungen auf Standardwerte zurücksetzen? Erteilte Website-Berechtigungen werden nicht entfernt.

buttonSkipForwardShortTitle.description: Short button label with title case.

emptyOpenVideoTab.message: Öffne einen Videotab, um ihn zu steuern.

emptyOpenVideoTryAgain.message: Öffne ein Video und versuche es erneut.

emptyEnableSiteInstruction.message: Klicke auf „Enable on this site“, um $HOSTNAME$ zu verwenden.

onboardingHeroSubtitle.message: Globale Tastenkürzel für Browser-Videos. Pausieren, springen und die Geschwindigkeit ändern, ohne den Editor zu verlassen.

onboardingDefaultChordsHint.message: Die vorgeschlagenen Kürzel für die unteren drei sind standardmäßig leer. Weise sie in den Chrome-Tastenkürzeln zu, oder passe Sprungintervall und Geschwindigkeitsschritt in den Einstellungen an.
onboardingDefaultChordsHint.description: Onboarding helper text. Contains trusted extension HTML.

onboardingMacCallout.message: Springen verwendet 8 und 9, weil macOS ⌘⇧3 bis ⌘⇧6 für Screenshots belegt. Du kannst alles unter chrome://extensions/shortcuts neu belegen.
onboardingMacCallout.description: Onboarding macOS note. Contains trusted extension HTML.

onboardingNonMacCallout.message: Springen verwendet standardmäßig 3 und 4. Du kannst alles unter chrome://extensions/shortcuts neu belegen.
onboardingNonMacCallout.description: Onboarding non-macOS note. Contains trusted extension HTML.

chromeOsGlobalCommandsNote.message: Hinweis: ChromeOS unterstützt keine globalen Befehle. Tastenkürzel funktionieren dort nur, wenn Chrome das fokussierte Fenster ist.

useItOnAnyVideoSiteDesc.message: Für YouTube, Vimeo, Udemy, Coursera und Bilibili bist du fertig. Für alles andere: Seite öffnen, Symbol in der Symbolleiste anklicken und Auf dieser Website aktivieren wählen.
useItOnAnyVideoSiteDesc.description: Onboarding helper text. Contains trusted extension HTML.

skipIntervalsDesc.message: Drei Sprunglängen, jeweils mit eigenen Zurück-/Vorspringen-Befehlen
skipIntervalsDesc.description: Settings group description for the three Skip intervals.

ahkWindowsOnly.description: Muted one-line note shown on non-Windows instead of the full AHK bridge configurator.

ahkBridgeTitle.description: AHK bridge panel title on the options Shortcuts section.

ahkBridgeDesc.message: advanced · optional — map External hotkeys to Commands
ahkBridgeDesc.description: AHK bridge panel short description marking the feature as advanced and optional.

ahkBridgeNote.message: Record OS-level External hotkeys for Commands, then download one AHK bridge script. Rows without a Chrome target chord can still be recorded; they are skipped in the script until bound.
ahkBridgeNote.description: AHK bridge panel helper note for External hotkey recording and download.

ahkBridgeGuidance.message: Install AutoHotkey v2, download the script, then run it (optionally start with Windows). Keep each Command set to Global in Chrome shortcut settings so SendInput still reaches PlaybackKeys while another app is focused.
ahkBridgeGuidance.description: Brief AutoHotkey v2 install/run guidance plus reminder that Commands must remain Global in Chrome.

ahkBrowserGateLabel.message: Only intercept while a browser is usable
ahkBrowserGateLabel.description: User-facing Browser gate toggle label (equivalent of 仅在有浏览器时拦截).

ahkBrowserGateDesc.message: Browser gate — on by default. Off claims External hotkeys system-wide while the AHK bridge script runs.
ahkBrowserGateDesc.description: Helper text under the Browser gate toggle explaining default-on and global-claim trade-off.

ahkBridgePathsGuidance.message: Path A: keep Browser gate on; if External hotkeys fail over an elevated game, run the AHK bridge script as Administrator. Path B: turn Browser gate off for system-wide capture without elevation (keys are swallowed in all apps while the script runs).
ahkBridgePathsGuidance.description: AHK panel dual-path guidance from ADR-0006: elevate with gate on, or gate off for global claim.

ahkClearMappings.description: Button that clears all External hotkey mappings, Bridge toggle hotkey, Browser gate, and related AHK bridge snapshot state.

ahkClearMappingsConfirm.message: Clear all External hotkey mappings, the remaps on/off hotkey, Browser gate, and AHK bridge download snapshot state?
ahkClearMappingsConfirm.description: Confirm dialog before clearing all AHK bridge companion storage, including the Bridge toggle hotkey and Browser gate.

ahkRecordExternal.description: Button to start External hotkey capture for a Command.

ahkClearExternal.description: Button to clear one Command External hotkey mapping.

ahkChromeTargetMissing.description: Shown when a Command has an External hotkey row but no chrome.commands shortcut yet.

ahkHighCollisionWarn.message: This External hotkey is commonly typed. While a supported browser window is usable, AutoHotkey will swallow it globally. Bind it anyway?
ahkHighCollisionWarn.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision External hotkey with Browser gate on.

ahkHighCollisionWarnGateOff.message: This External hotkey is commonly typed. AutoHotkey will swallow it in all applications while the AHK bridge script is running. Bind it anyway?
ahkHighCollisionWarnGateOff.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision External hotkey with Browser gate off (stronger global swallow warning).

ahkDownload.description: Button to download the generated AutoHotkey v2 AHK bridge script.

ahkDownloadDisabledReason.message: Need at least one External hotkey whose Command already has a Chrome target chord.
ahkDownloadDisabledReason.description: Shown beside Download when no complete External hotkey + Command chord row exists.

ahkSkipUnboundReason.description: Explains which mapped Commands are omitted from active AHK hotkey lines. $1 is a comma-separated Command list.

ahkDriftHint.message: AHK bridge settings or Chrome Command chords changed since the last download. Regenerate the AHK bridge script.
ahkDriftHint.description: Dismissible hint beside Download when Browser gate or live chrome.commands chords drift from the last generate snapshot.

ahkDriftDismiss.description: Dismiss the AHK chord-drift regenerate hint.

ahkBridgeToggleLabel.description: Friendly label for the optional Bridge toggle hotkey row in the AHK panel.

ahkBridgeToggleDesc.message: Optional — turns External hotkey remapping on or off without disabling this key
ahkBridgeToggleDesc.description: Helper text under the remaps on/off hotkey row.

ahkNoBridgeToggle.description: Empty placeholder when no remaps on/off hotkey is recorded.

ahkBridgeToggleConflict.message: That key is already used as an External hotkey. Choose a different remaps on/off key.
ahkBridgeToggleConflict.description: Reject saving a Bridge toggle hotkey that collides with an External hotkey.

ahkExternalConflictsWithBridgeToggle.message: That key is already used as the remaps on/off hotkey. Choose a different External hotkey.
ahkExternalConflictsWithBridgeToggle.description: Reject saving an External hotkey that collides with the Bridge toggle hotkey.

ahkBridgeToggleHighCollisionWarn.message: This key is commonly typed. AutoHotkey will swallow it globally while the AHK bridge script is running. Bind it anyway?
ahkBridgeToggleHighCollisionWarn.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision Bridge toggle hotkey (global while script runs).

ahkUnsupportedKey.message: That key is not supported. Try another.
ahkUnsupportedKey.description: Short tip while External hotkey / Bridge toggle recording stays open after an unmapped key press.
